```{r setup}

library(tcrClustR)
library(dplyr)
library(Seurat)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=TRUE, error=TRUE)

```

# Setup and Validate Inputs 

## Setup

```{r setupVariables, include=FALSE}

#load data and set required variables
seuratObj <- readRDS("../../tests/testdata/small_RIRA.rds")
outputPath <- tempdir()

#set default values for optional parameters
chains <- if(exists('chains')) chains else c("TRA", "TRB")
minimumCloneSize <- if(exists('minimumCloneSize')) minimumCloneSize else 2
resolutionParameters <- if(exists('resolutionParameters')) resolutionParameters else c(0.1)
pcaComponents <- if(exists('pcaComponents')) pcaComponents else 50
usePCA <- if(exists('usePCA')) usePCA else TRUE
verbose <- if(exists('verbose')) verbose else FALSE
pythonExecutable <- if(exists('pythonExecutable')) pythonExecutable else NULL

```

## Validation
```{r InputValidation}

#validate required inputs
if (!exists('seuratObj') || is.null(seuratObj)) {
  stop('seuratObj must be defined')
}
if (!exists('outputPath') || is.null(outputPath)) {
  stop('outputPath must be defined')
}
if (!inherits(seuratObj, "Seurat")) {
  stop('seuratObj must be a Seurat object with TCR metadata')
}
tcr_columns <- c("TRA", "TRB", "TRA_V", "TRA_J", "TRB_V", "TRB_J")
available_tcr_cols <- intersect(tcr_columns, colnames(seuratObj@meta.data))
if (length(available_tcr_cols) == 0) {
  stop("No TCR columns found in metadata. Please ensure TCR data is properly formatted.")
}
if (!dir.exists(outputPath)) {
  dir.create(outputPath, recursive = TRUE)
}

#initialize result objects
formatted_metadata <- NULL
seuratObj_TCR <- NULL
clustering_result <- NULL
seuratObj_clustered <- seuratObj
clustered_tcr_objects <- NULL

print("Input validation completed successfully")

```

# Data Overview

```{r DataOverview}

print("Seurat object summary:")
print(paste0("Number of cells: ", ncol(seuratObj)))
print(paste0("Number of features: ", nrow(seuratObj)))
print(paste0("Available TCR columns: ", paste(available_tcr_cols, collapse = ", ")))

```

# TCR Data Formatting

```{r FormatMetadata}

tryCatch({
  formatted_metadata <- .FormatMetadata(
    metadata = seuratObj@meta.data,
    chains = chains,
    minimumCloneSize = minimumCloneSize,
    outputPath = outputPath,
    outputCsvName = 'tcrDist3Input.csv',
    verbose = verbose
  )
  
  print("Formatted metadata summary:")
  print(paste0("Number of rows: ", nrow(formatted_metadata)))
  print(paste0("Number of columns: ", ncol(formatted_metadata)))
  print(paste0("Chains included: ", paste(chains, collapse = ", ")))
  
  #show first few rows
  knitr::kable(head(formatted_metadata, n = 5), caption = "First 5 rows of formatted metadata")
  
}, error = function(e){
  message("Error formatting metadata: ", e)
  traceback()
  stop("Cannot proceed without properly formatted metadata")
})

```

# TCR Distance Matrix Computation

```{r RunTcrdist3}

#validate that we have valid formatted metadata
if (is.null(formatted_metadata) || nrow(formatted_metadata) == 0) {
  stop("No valid formatted metadata available for distance computation")
}

tryCatch({
  seuratObj_TCR <- RunTcrdist3(
    inputData = seuratObj,
    chains = chains,
    cleanMetadata = cleanMetadata,
    minimumCloneSize = minimumCloneSize,
    pythonExecutable = pythonExecutable,
    verbose = verbose
  )
  
  print("TCR distance matrices computed successfully!")
  print(paste0("Available assays: ", paste(SeuratObject::Assays(seuratObj_TCR), collapse = ", ")))
  print(paste0("Number of cells in TCR object: ", ncol(seuratObj_TCR)))
  
}, error = function(e){
  message("Error computing TCR distances: ", e)
  traceback()
  stop("Cannot proceed without TCR distance matrices")
})

```

# TCR Clustering

```{r ClusterTCRs, fig.width = 15}

#validate that we have valid TCR distance object
if (is.null(seuratObj_TCR)) {
  stop("No TCR distance object available for clustering")
}

tryCatch({
  clustering_result <- ClusterTcrs(
    seuratObj = seuratObj,
    seuratObj_TCR = seuratObj_TCR,
    resolutionParameters = resolutionParameters,
    usePCA = usePCA,
    pcaComponents = pcaComponents
  )
  
  print("TCR clustering completed successfully!")
  
  #extract clustered objects
  if (is.list(clustering_result) && "seuratObj" %in% names(clustering_result)) {
    seuratObj_clustered <- clustering_result$seuratObj
    clustered_tcr_objects <- clustering_result$clusteredSeuratObjects
  } else {
    clustered_tcr_objects <- clustering_result
    seuratObj_clustered <- seuratObj
  }
  
  #show clustering columns that were added
  cluster_cols <- grep("TcrClustR_", colnames(seuratObj_clustered@meta.data), value = TRUE)
  if (length(cluster_cols) > 0) {
    print(paste0("Added clustering columns: ", paste(cluster_cols, collapse = ", ")))
  }
  
}, error = function(e){
  message("Error clustering TCRs: ", e$message)
  #set fallback values to allow report to continue
  seuratObj_clustered <- seuratObj
  clustered_tcr_objects <- NULL
})

```

# Visualization

```{r Visualization, fig.width = 15}

if (params$skipVisualization) {
  message("Skipping visualization as requested")
} else {
  
  #find clustering columns to determine visualization approach
  all_meta_cols <- colnames(seuratObj_clustered@meta.data)
  tcr_cols <- grep("TcrClustR_", all_meta_cols, value = TRUE)
  
  #generate visualizations based on available clustering results
  if (length(tcr_cols) > 0) {
    print(paste0("Found clustering columns: ", paste(tcr_cols, collapse = ", ")))
    
    tryCatch({
      TCRDistanceHeatmaps(
        seuratObj_TCR = seuratObj_clustered,
        resolution = resolutionParameters[1],
        annotate_clusters = TRUE,
        verbose = verbose
      )
    }, error = function(e){
      message("Error generating heatmaps: ", e)
    })
    
    tryCatch({
      TCRDistanceHistograms(
        seuratObj_TCR = seuratObj_clustered,
        resolution = resolutionParameters[1],
        verbose = verbose
      )
    }, error = function(e){
      message("Error generating histograms: ", e)
    })
    
  } else if (!is.null(clustered_tcr_objects)) {
    #use TCR-specific objects for visualization
    visualize_tcr_object <- function(tcr_obj, obj_name) {
      tcr_cols <- grep("TcrClustR_", colnames(tcr_obj@meta.data), value = TRUE)
      
      if (length(tcr_cols) == 0) {
        message("No clustering columns found for ", obj_name, ". Skipping visualization.")
        return()
      }
      
      tryCatch({
        TCRDistanceHeatmaps(
          seuratObj_TCR = tcr_obj,
          resolution = resolutionParameters[1],
          annotate_clusters = TRUE,
          verbose = verbose
        )
      }, error = function(e){
        message("Error generating heatmaps for ", obj_name, ": ", e)
      })
      
      tryCatch({
        TCRDistanceHistograms(
          seuratObj_TCR = tcr_obj,
          resolution = resolutionParameters[1],
          verbose = verbose
        )
      }, error = function(e){
        message("Error generating histograms for ", obj_name, ": ", e)
      })
    }
    
    #apply visualization to each TCR object
    for (i in seq_along(clustered_tcr_objects)) {
      obj_name <- names(clustered_tcr_objects)[i]
      if (is.null(obj_name)) obj_name <- paste("Object", i)
      visualize_tcr_object(clustered_tcr_objects[[i]], obj_name)
    }
    
  } else {
    message("No clustering results available for visualization")
  }
}

```

# Clustering Summary

```{r ClusteringSummary}
#summarization function
summarize_clusters <- function(obj, obj_name) {
  print(paste("##", obj_name, "Clustering Summary"))
  
  cluster_cols <- grep("TcrClustR_", colnames(obj@meta.data), value = TRUE)
  
  if (length(cluster_cols) == 0) {
    print("No TcrClustR clustering columns found")
    return()
  }
  
  for (col in cluster_cols) {
    cluster_table <- table(obj@meta.data[[col]], useNA = "ifany")
    print(paste0("Clusters for ", col, ":"))
    print(cluster_table)
    
    # Show non-NA cluster summary
    non_na_clusters <- cluster_table[!is.na(names(cluster_table))]
    if (length(non_na_clusters) > 0) {
      print(paste0("Number of non-NA clusters: ", length(non_na_clusters)))
      print(paste0("Total cells with cluster assignments: ", sum(non_na_clusters)))
    }
    
    na_count <- sum(is.na(obj@meta.data[[col]]))
    if (na_count > 0) {
      print(paste0("Number of cells without TCR clustering: ", na_count))
    }
  }
}

#summarize main Seurat object
if (exists("seuratObj_clustered") && !is.null(seuratObj_clustered)) {
  summarize_clusters(seuratObj_clustered, "Main Seurat Object")
}

#summarize TCR-specific objects
if (exists("clustered_tcr_objects") && !is.null(clustered_tcr_objects)) {
  print("## TCR-Specific Objects Clustering Summary")
  
  for (i in seq_along(clustered_tcr_objects)) {
    obj_name <- names(clustered_tcr_objects)[i]
    if (is.null(obj_name)) obj_name <- paste("Object", i)
    
    print(paste0("### ", obj_name))
    summarize_clusters(clustered_tcr_objects[[i]], obj_name)
  }
}

```
